title: Online correction statistics: observations/selection/method-bandit.json (Ingenium R3, SDK 0.5.0)
description: Written by the engine only when its constrained online correction is enabled (off by default). Per model version (budget table + initial knowledge), per situation signature, per arm (the planner that leads when both are eligible): the number of goal episodes n and the summed reward total (each reward is 0..1, so total <= n). Versions never mix. Counts and rewards only; never part of the canonical bundle.
